Question 4
?

Find the unit tangent vector to the curve r(t)=t2p(t) at the point corresponding to t=1, given that p(1)=i−j−k and p′(1)=−i+j+k.

a
3(i+j−2k)
b
33(i−j−k)
c
3(i+j−k)
d
2(i−j−k)
e
23(i+j−k)
